title: Optimization Concierge: intake form + lane matrix for advisory/tuning requests
creator: Nadia Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable, low-friction intake and triage system (the 'Optimization Concierge') for non-bug enterprise optimization requests relating to batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, and routing policies. The goal is to direct customers into the correct lane (self-serve, guided assist, or concierge engineering engagement) with clear SLAs, scorable triage, and handoff artifacts so Solutions/Eng can execute quickly and predictably. Acceptance criteria: 1) A one-page intake form deployed as a support portal template; 2) A documented lane matrix with decision thresholds and SLA targets; 3) A triage rubric with numeric scoring; 4) Clear handoff checklist and template PRD for eng work; 5) A pilot run with three enterprise customers and measured time-to-first-recommendation <= 7 days for 'Guided' lane and <= 14 days for 'Concierge' lane.
intake_form_fields: Workload profile (qps, avg seq length, peak patterns)
Cost objective (target $/1M tokens or relative % reduction)
Knobs of interest (batching | caching | quantization | routing | other)
Sample corpus or representative prompt set (link)
Observed failures or quality regressions (if any)
triage_rubric: Scoring dimensions (0-10 each): customer_value, cost_saving, latency_risk, regulatory_risk, engineering_effort, strategic_alignment
Weights: customer_value 30, cost_saving 25, latency_risk 15, regulatory_risk 10, engineering_effort 10, strategic_alignment 10 (sum 100)
Tie-breakers: enterprise contract size, SLO breach history, GCC/regulatory needs
Example: Customer X scores 72 -> Concierge lane because high cost saving potential + regulatory constraints
lane_matrix: Self-Serve: Automations + docs + example scripts. SLA: response within 3 business days with guidance links. Outcome: customer runs experiments themselves using docs and sample notebooks.

Guided (Solutions-led): 1:1 with Solutions engineer, 1-2 light experiments run by Solutions, suggested config diffs. SLA: initial reply 2 business days; first recommendation within 7 days. Expected eng effort: low (0-3 points).

Concierge (Eng + Solutions): Full advisory with dataset ingestion, benchmarking harness, config tuning, potential small runtime changes (e.g., KV cache policy tweak). SLA: initial reply 1 business day; deliverable within 14 days. Expected eng effort: medium-high (3-13 points) and may become ENG ticket for longer work.

Engineering Project: For work requiring runtime changes, new kernels, or infra changes. Triggered when triage indicates >13 points effort or risky changes. Hand-off to ENG with PRD, benchmark harness, and prioritization request. SLA: prioritized into next planning cycle per engineering intake.
Forbidden lane: Security-sensitive requests that cannot be served without Private deployment will be escalated to enterprise sales/Security for contract and architecture work.
handoff_checklist: Confirm intake form completeness and attach sample prompts/dataset
Run a quick smoke benchmark using standard harness and attach results
Populate triage rubric and record score in ticket
If Guided or Concierge lane: schedule kickoff with Solutions and customer within SLA window
If Eng project: create ENG-* ticket, include benchmark artifacts, expected impact, and acceptance criteria
Assign owner for follow-ups and weekly sync cadence
Record final recommendations in customer-facing runbook and internal playbook
decision_templates: Self-Serve approval template: canned reply with docs links, recommended batch_size/value ranges, quantization tradeoffs, and next steps
Guided engagement kickoff template: agenda, roles, data access checklist, test harness link
Concierge engagement PRD template: problem statement, current metrics, desired metrics, proposed experiments, rollback plan, safety/regulatory notes
pilot_plan: Select 3 enterprise customers from Solutions backlog who requested optimization in last 60 days
Run triage rubric and route them into lanes to validate thresholds
Measure: time-to-first-recommendation, implementation rate, measured cost reduction after 30 days
Collect feedback and iterate on intake fields and weightings
Target: reduce average time-to-recommendation for Guided lane from current ~12 days to <=7 days
metrics_and_kpis: Conversion rate from recommendation -> customer implementation
Measured cost/unit token reduction after 30 days
Number of eng tickets created from concierge lane and average lead time
